channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: Lock and mint vs burn and mint: choose by token support
item.description: Lock and mint vs burn and mint bridges: burn and mint preserves canonical supply when issuers control each chain; lock and mint broadens coverage but concentrates vault risk.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2B in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion in Binance theft proceeds, within $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds; tracing and forfeiture work continues.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority over more than $1.2 billion of Binance theft proceeds as US and private partners continue tracking the stolen crypto.

item.title: US secures court authority over $1.2B in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says court-authorized action covers more than $1.2 billion of Binance theft proceeds, while U.S. and private-sector freezes exceed $2.7 billion.

item.title: US wins seizure authority over $1.2bn in Binance hack crypto
item.description: DOJ says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion stolen from Binance, with tracing and forfeiture efforts still under way.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2bn in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department secured court authority over more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance; tracing and forfeiture efforts remain underway.

item.title: US gets court authority over $1.2B in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department secured court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack funds, part of $2.7 billion frozen as recovery efforts continue.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, expanding blockchain choice for payments settled in stablecoins.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa added Monad on Nov. 10 for stablecoin settlement by participating issuers and acquirers, adding another blockchain route for settling card obligations around the clock.

item.title: NYSE affiliate selects Avalanche for tokenized stock settlement
item.description: The NYSE affiliate will use Avalanche ledger technology to clear and settle tokenized securities on a planned 24/7 trading venue, pending regulatory approval.

item.title: Schwab Opens Crypto Trading in SOL, AVAX and LINK
item.description: Charles Schwab added SOL, AVAX and LINK to Schwab Crypto on Nov. 9, expanding direct trading beyond bitcoin and ether for eligible U.S. retail clients.

item.title: Payward fund and clients buy undisclosed AAVE stake
item.description: Payward’s affiliated fund and asset-management clients bought an undisclosed amount of AAVE on secondary markets, with more purchases possible as the firms explore cooperation.

item.title: FinCEN Orders U.S. Firms to Block Transfers Involving MEXC
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. firms to block transfers involving MEXC over at least $16 billion in alleged illicit flows; the restriction takes effect after Federal Register publication.

item.title: FinCEN orders US transfer block on MEXC over alleged $16B
item.description: FinCEN ordered US firms to block MEXC transfers, citing at least $16 billion in alleged illicit flows linked to sanctions evasion and cybercrime over five years.

item.title: Consensys launches stack to link institutional ledgers
item.description: Consensys launched a four-workflow stack for routing institutional transactions across independent ledgers, keeping assets on native networks as EVM connections open.

item.title: When does shiba swap make sense for a token trade?
item.description: ShibaSwap can suit a token trade when its pool route offers a fair price after fees, gas and slippage; compare the final amount before you confirm.

item.title: Akash stakers approve Solana move, staking ends at cutover
item.description: Akash voters approved moving the protocol from Cosmos to Solana, authorizing a 1:1 AKT token launch; current staking continues until a separate cutover vote.

item.title: Bitcoin slips below $76,000 as AI selloff hits crypto stocks
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $76,000 as AI-linked shares sold off, pulling down crypto companies and triggering more than $1 billion in leveraged liquidations.

item.title: CFTC opens US market to single-stock perpetual futures
item.description: The CFTC says single-stock perpetual futures can begin trading on registered US exchanges, with SEC notice registration required for security-futures markets.
